subject: [Unsolved error message] Dynamic index out of bound

messages.author: 8bde8f223015bf6f
messages.subject: [Unsolved error message] Dynamic index out of bound
parts:
Hello everyone,
This is my first time on this Google group. :)

I hope my question has not already been asked.

I send you this message because I'm trying to run a capture-mark-recapture CJS model (to estimate survival probability) using the Nimble package on a very large dataset: 6515 individuals (rows) across 25 years (columns).

The problem is that when trying to run the simplest model with no individual variable explaining the survival probability (I just add a random temporal effect on both the probability of capture and the probability of survival), when calculating the Likelihood, I get an error message indicating that "Dynamic index is out of bound". However, when running the same model on a smaller dataset (i.e., less individuals and/or less years), no error message appears.

Do you have any idea about what is the problem here and how to fix it?
I sincerely thank you all in advance for your feedbacks,

Best,
Sophie

messages.author: d78486bfff620d81
messages.subject: Re: [Unsolved error message] Dynamic index out of bound
parts:
hi Sophie,

The "Dynamic index is out of bound" message suggests you have code in your model something like `x[z]` where `z` is an unknown. If the value of `z` is beyond the length of `x`, then this could occur. You might need to provide a valid initial value for `z`. That might be enough to help you figure out what is going on, but if not, please share your model code. Someone might be able to help based on that, or if it not, then we'd need the full data and code to be able to reproduce the issue.

-chris
